author: bardic-inspiration
name: The Warren King's Court
summary: A goblin king holds court in a drowned shrine, guarded by his hexer and his boss.

parts.text: Candles float on the black water around a dais of stacked crates. On it, a goblin in a crown of bent spoons bangs a ladle for silence.

parts.trigger: The party steps into the shrine, or attacks from the Flooded Hall.

stages.name: The Audience
stages.loop: The king demands tribute while the hexer circles behind the party. Nobody attacks until a goblin is hurt or the tribute is refused.
stages.transition: Steel is drawn, or the hexer finishes her circle.

stages.name: The Brawl
stages.loop: The boss holds the dais stairs; the hexer curses whoever hurts the king; the king throws whatever is to hand.
stages.transition: The boss falls, or the king drops below half his Hit Points.

stages.name: The Flight
stages.loop: The king dives for the Overflow tunnel while the hexer covers his escape.

parts.victory: The king is caught or slain before he reaches the Overflow.

parts.title: The King's Hoard
parts.text:
| d4 | Treasure |
|---|---|
| 1 | A sack of 300 CP |
| 2 | A tin crown set with river glass |
| 3 | A {ref:item/potion-of-climbing} |
| 4 | All of the above |
